categories.order: tracking or changes to an order already placed: where it is, when it will arrive, changing the address, the invoice
categories.return: wants to return a product or exchange it for another one, or asks about their refund
categories.fault: a product doesn't work, is broken or has a defect; warranty and repairs
categories.inquiry: questions before buying: products, sizes, prices, shipping, opening hours
categories.complaint: complains about how they were treated, the customer service or the store's service
